urlText: Mount Kembla bus service changes
content:
Some bus services on route 36, S098 and S101 bus services will terminate earlier and not run after Cordeaux Rd due to roadworks. 

Buses will now terminate at Araluen Avenue, Mt Kembla Village and will not travel beyond this point. 
 
From Thursday 12 June, a shuttle bus will run for school students between Mt Kembla and Cordeaux Rd near Araluen Ave to connect them to their regular school services. The shuttle will depart from Harry Graham Dr at 7.55am each weekday connecting with the S098, and will connect with the S098 and S101 at 3.33pm each afternoon. This shuttle bus is an initiative between bus operator Premier and Wollongong City Council.

Plan ahead and allow extra travel time.

urlText: L4 Westmead and Carlingford Line weekend full closure due to maintenance
content:
On Saturday 12 and Sunday 13 July, L4 Westmead and Carlingford Line light rail services will be not run due to planned trackwork and maintenance works.
 
During this time, use alternative transport including L4 replacement bus services, trains, regular bus services or walking if able, between Westmead and Carlingford.
 
Replacement bus services will run every 10 to 15 minutes from 5am to 1am daily. These times may vary depending on road traffic.
 
Replacement buses will not stop at the following locations:
  • Westmead Hospital – Please use the alternative stop at Westmead Station (approx. 6 minute walk)
  • Ngara (towards Westmead) – Please use the alternative stop at Benaud Oval (approx. 5 minute walk)
  • Rosehill Gardens – Please use the alternative stop at Tramway Avenue (approx. 10 minute walk)
Most replacement buses will be accessible; if not, wait for the next service.
 
See news story for more detailed service information.
 
Allow extra travel time and use the Trip Planner or check travel alerts to see if your travel is affected.
